arguments.cover_letter:
You need a test suite running in CI for your SaaS business, and the projects below are the closest matches from my portfolio.

On Checkout redesign for an e-commerce client I used React, Jest, TypeScript and raised checkout completion from 61% to 74%.

On Test suite for a legacy app for a fintech client I used Jest, TypeScript, React and took coverage from 12% to 78% and halved regressions.

On Subscription billing dashboard for a SaaS client I used TypeScript and recovered 9% of failed payments automatically.

I can start this week. Would a 20 minute call suit you to confirm scope and milestones?
screening_answers: The closest match is Checkout redesign, where I raised checkout completion from 61% to 74%.
